ns2:section.sectionText: This is an online course taught in the Moodle course management system with no classroom sessions. Synchronous discussion sessions meet for one hour per week, and asynchronous course activity due dates are spaced out during the week. A final video project will be submitted online instead of a F-2-F final lecture exam. Additional course information is available at http://www.life.illinois.edu/bio100/ib100onl.html. Register for both the Online Lecture and Online Discussion
